quote_only: No published price: samsara.com/pricing is a fleet-size form and samsara.com/resources/plans names seven packages, each with a Get pricing button and no amount (read 10 Oct 2026)
No published price: none of the three tiers (Platform, Scale, Managed) shows a figure anywhere on the site, including the self-serve entry tier (read 4 Sep 2026)
No published price: Starter, Team and Business all route to a Talk to sales button (read 27 Aug 2026)
per_seat: (read 2026-10-27 on nexgenvirtualworkplace.net, SMB Market page; the Enterprise and Webex pages were read on 2026-10-20; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) NexGen prices its virtual workplace per user for companies with 1 to 100 employees, all with self implementation: $25 per user paid monthly (cancel anytime), $20 per user a month paid quarterly ($60 per quarter) or $15 per user a month paid yearly ($180 per year).

For teams, Business is €9.99 per user a month with 1 TB per user and Business Pro €14.98 per user a month with 2 TB per user (€44.94 a month for 3 users, marked down from €59.94, for new accounts only), both with a minimum of 3 users and pCloud Encryption included; Business has a 30-day free trial.

(read 2026-10-25 on recruitcrm.io/pricing/ with both the Annually and the Monthly toggle clicked, from the Netherlands, where the page shows euros; and in the Recruit CRM help centre) Pro is €79 per user a month billed annually or €95 monthly, with 100 credits per user a month.
usage_metered: (read 2026-10-26 on lensmor.com/pricing and Lensmor's billing policy in its help centre; dollar amounts, the pages do not name the currency) Lensmor sells credits.

There are two meters, and the second one is easy to miss: every conversation that touches an AI block counts as an AI chat at €0.10 beyond the allowance, on top of regular chat overage sold in €25 packs.

(read 2026-10-25 on recruitcrm.io/pricing/ with both the Annually and the Monthly toggle clicked, from the Netherlands, where the page shows euros; and in the Recruit CRM help centre) Pro is €79 per user a month billed annually or €95 monthly, with 100 credits per user a month.
renewal_jump: The yearly services renew at a price: the registered office address £29 a year plus VAT, the director's service address £28, business mail forwarding £98, and the Premium filing service £128 a year excluding VAT, with the £50 Companies House confirmation statement fee paid separately.

(read 2026-10-12 in a live browser on hostpapa.com/web-hosting-plan and hostpapa.com/renewal-pricing; US site, prices in US dollars excluding taxes) Shared web hosting comes in four cPanel plans, each shown at a promotional price that the page says applies to the first term only, on a 3-year discounted term, for new customers.
Taking payments needs a paid bundle, and every bundle renews at twice the first-year price: Earth $398, Universe $598 and Infinity $1,598 a year.
addons_extra: An optional Backup add-on is listed as $6.99 to $59.99 a month; the listing does not break that range down.
Active paid subscribers can buy add-on credits: 10,000 for $249, 25,000 for $549 or 60,000 for $1,199, valid for 12 months.
For personal plans, client-side encryption is a separate add-on: €150 once (from €229).
annual_lock: Basic is $499 a month or $4,990 a year, for 35,000 credits a month and a shared workspace of up to 5 seats; the credits reset every month, also on annual billing.

(read 2026-10-26 on yaps.ai/pricing with annual billing selected; the monthly price was read on 2026-10-16; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) Yaps is free on Android, iPhone and iPad: voice typing in other apps, voice notes with local search and read-aloud with 4 voices, without an account or card.
Prices are before tax, and annual billing is a 12-month commitment.
free_tier: (read 2026-10-26 on the EditEngine listing in the Shopify App Store; the listing says all charges are billed in USD, every 30 days) EditEngine has a free plan and three paid plans, and every plan allows unlimited bulk edit, import and export tasks.

(read 2026-10-25 on landbot.io/pricing with both the Annual and the Monthly toggle clicked, and in Landbot's billing FAQ at help.landbot.io) Free is €0 for 100 chats a month, one seat, the full builder and templates, and a WhatsApp test number, but no AI chats.

The first billing period is discounted: the Superdeal table shows the first 3 months of all three plans at $0, and the Promotion table shows Start at $0 for a first month or quarter or $112.50 for a first year, Business at $0, $112.50 or $225, and Pro at $0, $225 or $450.
